qa_pairs.instruction: What does the Network Security section of the Bi Impl Mid I driver require for users who are outside the corporate firewall?
qa_pairs.output: The Network Security section of the Bi Impl Mid I driver requires that users outside of the corporate firewall use a VPN to access corporate data.

qa_pairs.instruction: Summarize the network security requirement outlined in the Bi Impl Mid I driver.
qa_pairs.output: In the Bi Impl Mid I driver, any user accessing corporate data from outside the corporate firewall must first connect through a VPN.
